validation_rules: the producer selection is computed by Python from the accepted publications present in the run; every enrichment profile is listed as included or excluded with a disposition and reason
an absent, skipped, failed, inadmissible, other-generation, unselectable or not-indexable producer is a coverage gap, never an empty result

included producers are admitted by evidence_index_enrichment.load_producer (common pointer, envelope, attempt tree, result schema, F02 receipts) and must carry this run's source generation; each record keeps its producer's build lineage

build inputs come only from the accepted 02-native-build: build-dependencies.json records and hash-bound generated headers; out-of-checkout headers are indexed by path, sha256 and package, and their unretained bytes are a gap
producer text documents come only from a derived-text-manifest.json the producer's accepted envelope lists, each document hash-bound to the envelope
text is chunked only within the file-count, byte, total-byte and line-length bounds and as strict UTF-8; every document outside them is listed with its status and a gap
evidence-index-enrichment.json validates against its closed schema; the SQLite rows equal it and hash to content_sha256, and every validate re-derives both from the bound inputs
rows are locators and untrusted data that require producer record and source dereference before citation
